business_summary: Omni-Plus System Limited engages in the manufacture and distribution of commodity and engineering plastics in Southeast Asia, Asia, the Americas, and internationally. It also offers generic and specialty engineering plastics materials; and resin compounds, as well as engineering plastics for housing and built-in parts in their products, including household electrical appliances, electronic devices, office automation equipment, automobiles, communication-related equipment, and medical equipment. It serves supply chain management, engineering, consulting solutions, and other industries. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Singapore.
